review_candidates.title: IT Governance Officer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Title: IT Governance Officer Department: Information Technology / IT Governance Reports To: Head of IT Governance Job Overview: An IT Governance Officer ensures that technology investments directly align with strategic business goals while managing risk and maintaining regulatory compliance across standard frameworks like COBIT and ISO/IEC 38500. Key Responsibilities: Framework Management: Implement and maintain enterprise IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ITIL, ISO 27001) to structure
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Policy & Compliance: Draft, update, and monitor adherence to IT policies, procedures, and service level agreements (SLAs) to meet regulatory requirements (e.g., FRA). Required Qualifications & Experience: Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering or related field.
